build_cifar_resnet_model: build a CIFAR-10 ResNet model from a name like cifar_resnet_20 with an initializer
create_resnet_block: create a ResNet Block with two conv layers, batch norm, and a residual shortcut connection
test_is_valid_model_name: test whether a string like cifar_resnet_20_16 is a valid ResNet model name
review_default_hparams: review the default hyperparameters for model, dataset, training, and pruning config
summarize_forward_pass: summarize the forward pass through conv, blocks, avg pool, and final linear layer
